allocation_complete.reason: The core BMS-relevant obligation, a permitted charging power the vehicle can rely on, has no allocated BMS requirement (the element states this open point); the allocated needs are only loosely related.
allocation_complete.suggestion: Have the BMS team add an interface requirement publishing the permitted charging power (20-80 % SoC, 25 C) and allocate it.

interface_only.reason: BMS_REQ_CELL_VOLTAGE_LIMITS, HEATING_REQUEST and COOLING_REQUEST are BMS interface needs, bev-gated like the element.

no_value_copy.reason: The voltage window is referenced via the chemistry / allocated need, no value restated.

parent_fit.reason: Addresses the safe cell window and thermal conditioning around charging, but not the parent's actual obligation of accepting at least the required average charging power.
parent_fit.suggestion: Engage with the minimum accepted charging power (a permitted charging power published by the BMS) once the BMS provides it.

variant_consistency.reason: Variant folder subsystems/bms (bev), same as the bev-gated parent.
